reply.text: {"say":"Rows lead and carry the session for thickness, with one vertical pull to keep the lats honest and rear delts to finish the upper back.","title":"Back Thickness","days":[{"name":"Back Thickness","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bent-over-row","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pull to the lower ribs, pause briefly"},{"key":"barbell-pendlay-row","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Reset on the floor each rep"},{"key":"single-arm-dumbbell-row","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive the elbow back, squeeze at the top"},{"key":"close-grip-cable-seated-row","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Chest tall, no swinging"},{"key":"neutral-grip-cable-lat-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pull elbows down to your sides"},{"key":"cable-face-pull","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pull to the face, elbows high"}]}],"unmet":[]}
